summary: Use the built-in audit support, logging and activity stream to audit AAP, and send AAP and RHEL logs to a central external logging system instead of reviewing them locally; events must be time-correlated for forensic analysis.
questions: How do I audit changes in AAP?
Should AAP logs be sent to a central log server?
What does the AAP activity stream record?
Why is log time correlation important for AAP?
